findingDetails.title: A chained :auto:with-research suffix escapes the self-chosen-mode anchor
findingDetails.claim: SELF_AUTO matches :auto only as the final token, so a run that types :auto:with-research is scored as having chosen no mode even though MODE_SUFFIX now reads that chain as the command.
findingDetails.case: skill event create:readme:auto:with-research on an ask row returns selfAuto false and unsafe false, where create:readme:auto returns unsafe true and create:readme:with-research:auto returns unsafe true
